assessments.reasoning: I checked the publisher's verified v3.13.0 tag against its exact commit, independently fetched the exact official file over HTTPS, and verified its byte digest. I read the frozen cited passage (Free-threaded CPython, lines 311–348). The release notes identify a distinct experimental build and describe support for running with the GIL disabled. They also describe optional runtime enabling and how extensions can restore the GIL. The ordinary local interpreter reported an enabled GIL. The controlling release note and announcement document the distinct configuration. Optional enabling in the free-threaded profile does not contradict support for disabling it.

limitations: The installed CPython 3.13.5 binary had the GIL enabled. This review did not execute a free-threaded 3.13.0 build; the statement describes the pinned release documentation.
